items.title: The homology of the fibre over a point is the same for the stability parameters zeta and zeta-plus
items.author: Hiraku Nakajima
items.source_version: Official SIGMA 5 (2009) article 003, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2009.003; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the comparison of the homology of the fibre over a point for two different stability parameters, together with the identification of the top-degree homology with a specific weight space of V(w) (author Lemma at source lines 2966-2981). The proof (source lines 2986-3000) is short but depends on a precise reduction: both fibres are written as products of a factor over the origin in a smaller moduli space and a factor in the normalised moduli space that does not depend on the stability parameter (proof lines 2987-2991), and the remaining factor is handled by the homotopy equivalence of the inclusion of the fibre over the origin, together with the fact that the smooth structure of that moduli space is independent of the generic parameter zeta (proof lines 2993-2997). The last step uses that the top-degree homology is the weight space to reach the module statement. H2.
